name: Jean Fouquet

summary.text: Jean Fouquet was a French painter and miniaturist. A master of panel painting and manuscript illumination, and the apparent inventor of the portrait miniature, he is considered one of the most important painters from the period between the late Gothic and early Renaissance.

1671114: The Hours of Étienne Chevalier is an illuminated book of hours commissioned by Étienne Chevalier, treasurer to King Charles VII of France, from the miniature painter and illuminator Jean Fouquet.
2589776: The Melun Diptych is a two-panel oil painting by the French court painter Jean Fouquet created around 1452. The name of this diptych came from its original home in the Collegiate Church of Notre-Dame in Melun.
